issues.failure_explanation: Between eq_estEtniDelFtnij and eq_estDelFtnij the term E[ρ²(E_{t_{n,j}}ΔΘ^{n+1}−E_{t_{n,i}}ΔΘ^{n+1})] is replaced by E[ρ²(ΔΘ^{n+1})−ρ²(E_{t_n}ΔΘ^{n+1})]. This is the conditional-variance (Pythagoras) identity and is false for a general seminorm: with ρ = ℓ¹ on R², ΔΘ^{n+1} = (1,0) or (0,1) with probability 1/2 and F_{t_n}=F_{t_{n,i}} trivial, F_{t_{n,j}} complete, the left side is E‖X−EX‖₁² = 1 while the right side is E‖X‖₁²−‖EX‖₁² = 1−1 = 0. Hence eq_proveDPhi with its variance term is not established for the seminorms allowed by assu_FLipVar (it is valid when ρ comes from an inner product, as in lem_m_fnoz and lem_m_linearf).
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Restrict ρ in assu_FLipVar to seminorms induced by an inner product, or add the conditional-variance inequality E[ρ²((E_s−E_t)X)] ≤ E[ρ²(X)−ρ²(E_{t_n}X)] as a hypothesis; then the displayed estimate follows from conditional Jensen and martingale orthogonality and every stated rate is preserved.
issues.overall_effect: lemm_LipVarRK and therefore the stability, error and convergence theorems stated for an arbitrary seminorm ρ are not established as written; the negative variance term they rely on cannot be produced in that generality. All concrete applications (no-z and linear generators with Euclidean ρ) remain covered.
issues.title: Conditional-variance step in the RK Lipschitz lemma fails for general seminorms
issues.why_classification: The resolution is a limited weakening of a hypothesis (or a new conditional-variance lemma) rather than a routine local edit: the stability/convergence architecture and all rates survive, but the advertised generality of the seminorm is lost.
